coauthors.relevance_evidence: Co-first author (equal contribution) of 'MOSAIC: A Dataset for Cultural Dimension Evaluation in Arabic LLMs': README states the dataset is '1,483 Arabic social dilemmas across five cultural dimensions' and is 'a dataset and evaluation pipeline for studying how Arabic and multilingual large language models respond to social dilemmas across cultural value dimensions', grounded in Hofstede's Power Distance / Individualism-Collectivism / Masculinity-Femininity / Uncertainty Avoidance / Long-Term Orientation. This is cultural-values evaluation of LLMs directly. No email found on any page (GitHub user seifeddine911, 'Freelance Front-End Developer', Tunisia, is a possible but unconfirmed match and shows no email).

coauthors.relevance_evidence: Coauthor of 'MOSAIC: A Dataset for Cultural Dimension Evaluation in Arabic LLMs' (README/bibtex: author = {Benhadjali, Nadhem and Hamdi, Seifeddine and Abbes, Istabrak and Messaoud, Safa and Arous, Ines}), whose stated purpose is 'studying how Arabic and multilingual large language models respond to social dilemmas across cultural value dimensions' using Hofstede dimensions - i.e. cultural-values evaluation in LLMs. Caveat: her indexed arXiv output otherwise covers continual pre-training, layer importance and groundedness detection, with no cultural dimension; MOSAIC is the single culture/values work.

coauthors.relevance_evidence: Senior coauthor of 'MOSAIC: A Dataset for Cultural Dimension Evaluation in Arabic LLMs': the dataset measures LLM option preferences on Arabic social dilemmas 'across cultural value dimensions' (Hofstede's five dimensions), and the README warns it must be used 'to analyze model behavior, not to define what any culture is' - explicit cultural-values/bias work in LLMs. Caveat: her other indexed work (fact editing, multi-document summarization, peer-review AI support) is not culture-related; MOSAIC is the culture/values anchor.
